{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Inspect the first few rows
print(penguins.head())

# Check for missing values
print("\nMissing values:")
print(penguins.isnull().sum())

# Check data types
print("\nData types:")
print(penguins.dtypes)

# Check for duplicates
print(f"Number of duplicate rows: {penguins.duplicated().sum()}")

# Check the distribution of the two variables
print("\nFlipper length (mm) - Summary:")
print(penguins['flipper_length_mm'].describe())

print("\nBody mass (g) - Summary:")
print(penguins['body_mass_g'].describe())"}
